notes: This benchmark makes hard-case selection adaptive: the generated candidate pool is screened, hard/failing cases receive refined probing, the hardest cases are selected, and any final candidate failure fails the benchmark.
The solver receives only repeated noisy f(x,y) oracle calls; no teacher weights, layer widths, hidden activations, or adversarial profile labels are passed to GCL.
